matchInput: I want to open a shop
aliases: I want to open a store
disclaimer: This is a planning outline and cost estimate only. It is not legal, tax, or regulatory advice. Hire an appropriate licensed professional for compliance matters.

steps.title: Hire a graphic designer for the shop's logo and brand identity
steps.why: A clear brand comes first because the logo gets reused on signage, packaging, and social media. Doing it early avoids re-work in every later step.

steps.title: Hire a photographer for shopfront and product photos
steps.why: Product and shopfront photos are the base assets for your website and Facebook page. Shooting after the brand is set means you only shoot once.

steps.title: Hire a web developer for a basic website or landing page
steps.why: A simple site with location, hours, and what you sell helps customers find and trust the shop before they visit.

steps.title: Hire a social media manager for Facebook and Instagram
steps.why: Regular posting around the opening builds an audience and keeps promotions visible. Starting after photos and brand are ready makes the feed consistent from day one.

steps.title: Engage a company-registration specialist for legal setup
steps.why: Registration and tax paperwork should be handled by an appropriate professional. This step names the professional type only — it is not advice.
